aboutGame.title: Acerca de Build a Boss
paragraphs: Build a Boss es una experiencia PvE de estilo pixel en Roblox donde los jugadores recolectan piezas como armas, láseres y armaduras para diseñar y derrotar a formidables jefes.
Con 75 niveles distribuidos en 10 zonas temáticas, pon a prueba tus creaciones en intensas batallas en solitario o con amigos para desbloquear botín exclusivo.

items.question: ¿Qué es Build a Boss en Roblox?
items.answer: Build a Boss is a 2D pixel-art PvE building game developed by taapr studios on Roblox where players assemble custom bosses from guns, lasers, and armor, then battle through 75 levels across 10 zones.

items.question: How do I get more Cash and Gems in Build a Boss?
items.answer: In Build a Boss, you earn Cash and Gems by clearing PvE battle levels. You can repeat completed stages for quick Cash and reach zone milestone stars for bonus Gems.

items.question: What are the best parts to upgrade first in Build a Boss?
items.answer: In early Build a Boss stages, prioritize weapon firepower such as rapid-fire guns and piercing lasers to clear stages quickly, then invest into heavier protective armor for later zones.

items.question: Are there active codes for Build a Boss?
items.answer: Check our Build a Boss Codes guide regularly for any newly released developer codes, reward redemptions, and instructions on unlocking free in-game currency.

items.question: How many levels and zones are currently in Build a Boss?
items.answer: Build a Boss currently features 75 levels distributed across 10 distinct zones, with each level presenting unique enemy encounters and 3-star rating goals.
